verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for an incident-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Rootly's source (or its MCP server's source) published under an open license. A downloadable OpenAPI spec and public APIs are interface descriptions, not readable product source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
